* EapAkaMethodStateMachine represents the valid paths possible for the EAP-AKA protocol. * *

EAP-AKA sessions will always follow the path: * * Created --+--> Identity ->+--+>----> Challenge ------>+-> Final * | ^ v ^ ^ * | | | | | * +---------------+ +--> Re-authentication --+ * *

Note: If the EAP-Request/AKA-Challenge message contains an AUTN with an invalid sequence * number, the peer will indicate a synchronization failure to the server and a new challenge will * be attempted. * *

Note: EAP-Request/Notification messages can be received at any point in the above state * machine At most one EAP-AKA/Notification message is allowed per EAP-AKA session. * * @see RFC 4187, Extensible Authentication Protocol * for Authentication and Key Agreement (EAP-AKA)
